name: basic-tools-surface
description: read(path,offset,limit,display), edit(ops[]), write(ops[]), grep(pattern,path,type,hidden,max_depth,display), find(ops[]), ls(path,recursive,display), shell(command,timeout,env,readonlyShell), ast_search(query,path,language,glob,limit,display), revert_file(path,checkpoint_id?). All in basic-tools extension. No bash tool (remove-bash hook removes it).

name: context-tools-surface
description: ctx_record(content,tags?,anchor?), ctx_packet(query?,format?), ctx_inject(content,at?). Context extension. Ephemeral session injection layer — distinct from grove (grove=persistent semantic store, context=session scratchpad/injection).

name: shell-nushell-syntax
description: Shell tool executes Nushell NOT POSIX/bash. Forbidden patterns: 2>/dev/null, 2>&1, &&, ||, $(), backticks. Nu equivalents: out+err>| for redirect, ; for sequence, prefix external binary with ^ if shadowed by Nu builtin (e.g. ^ls). POSIX idioms silently fail or produce wrong output in Nu.

name: display-patterns
description: display:auto default. Collapsed count: 0=muted '0 matches', truncated=success 'N of M matches', complete=success 'N matches'. Expanded: grep uses batContextHighlight (amber bg on matched text, auto language from ext). find: eza --color=always --icons --oneline --group-directories-first. ast_search: eza --oneline + dim '(N match/matches)' suffix. read: bat --line-range startLine:endLine. Truncation footers: find/grep '… N more', read '── N of M lines · M more'.

name: parity-gaps
description: Priority order: 1)grep context param (-B N -A N rg flags; batContextHighlight already ready), 2)grep glob param (--glob rg flag), 3)edit fuzzy matching (delegate to linehash edit --fuzzy; Unicode/whitespace/trim normalization), 4)find sortBy(name/mtime/size)/modifiedSince/minSize/maxSize, 5)computeDiff→linehash diff (removes Index:/=== from content.text LLM view). read image/symbol lookup: low urgency.

name: readonly-shell-contract
description: readonlyShell (camelCase), readonly_shell (alias), PI_READONLY_SHELL=1 (env) all activate Bubblewrap sandbox. Normal shell unchanged without activation. Readonly details include readonlyShell:true, sandbox metadata, standard shell fields. Bubblewrap is the hard boundary for readonly; AgentFS/YoloFS is the outer wall for permission-gate.
